body: BigXthaPlug is bringing “Better Over Time” to life with his new short film, and fans online are already saying they want the trailer turned into a FULL MOVIE Coming off his first 1 on Billboard’s Top Rap Albums chart, BigX is adding another dimension to the project and giving fans a new way to experience “Better Over Time” The trailer has people wanting more, would you watch a full-length BigX movie?
